plan: Represent the adapted recipe as a fresh structure built from copies; never mutate recipe, request, or catalog, and keep authored_text untouched so print_original is byte-for-byte.
Compute one exact scale factor target_yield/recipe yield with fractions.Fraction and apply it to every quantity, including component ingredients and substitution-added ingredients.

Resolve each ingredient through a substitution chain: while its name is excluded, pick the catalog choice with lowest (priority, catalog index); apply quantity_factor, unit, preparation, wording_changes, equipment adds/removals, yield_factor, and queue additional_ingredients for the same resolution.

Detect reintroduced exclusions by a per-chain seen-name set: a new excluded name chains again with a warning; a name already seen yields the reason 'substitution cycle involving NAME'; a missing catalog entry yields 'no substitution for NAME'.

Collect reasons additively across all ingredients, components, and the equipment check (final equipment = authored + adds - removals, sorted, each missing item -> 'equipment NAME unavailable'), so impossibility reports every independent reason, sorted.
Adapt optional components in an isolated effects record: on failure drop the component with a warning; mandatory component failures merge into global reasons.
Apply accumulated wording (old,new) pairs to all instruction strings only when adaptation succeeds; return {possible, recipe|None, ordered choice ids, sorted warnings, sorted reasons}.
mechanisms: seen-set substitution chaining with cycle detection
additive reason collection across independent checks
effects accumulator (wording, equipment deltas, yield factor, warnings, choices)
isolated adaptation sandbox for optional components
